Enclosing class:
SyncMcpResourceMethodCallback
public static final class SyncMcpResourceMethodCallback.Builder extends AbstractMcpResourceMethodCallback.AbstractBuilder<SyncMcpResourceMethodCallback.Builder, SyncMcpResourceMethodCallback>
用于创建 SyncMcpResourceMethodCallback 实例的构建器。

该构建器提供了一个流式 API，用于构建具有所需参数的 SyncMcpResourceMethodCallback 实例。
